findings.evidence: CustodyOwnerOperationHandler only implements Methods/Handle. Default IsReadOnly=false and default RecoverAsync throws; stable DaprCustodyOwnerCallSource payloads therefore admit once then reject repeated read-current/verify framing. The handler itself reads current/control originals and signs framing, rather than executing the owner transition.
findings.route: patch — correctly classify framing and verify repeated actual receiving calls

findings.evidence: Runner sets attempt_state=ReservationUnknown before reserve but leaves the earlier signed-absence effect state NotDispatched. Another coordinator may already have reserved/dispatched when this response is lost; the failure then reports zero.
findings.route: patch — set conservative effect uncertainty before reserve and test the race

findings.evidence: FR34 RecoverAsync delegates to HandleAsync for unseal/replay. Their actual unprotect paths call the material provider; after a prior holder completes, retry can allocate another read profile and produce a later outcome under the admitted original.
findings.route: patch — exact retained/native result or Unknown, without another read release

findings.evidence: Lifecycle Execute retains any non-null actual outcome; delivery Execute likewise retains Unknown/Unavailable. Both Lookup methods return that case-result before consulting native originals, permanently sealing transient uncertainty even when completion is later readable.
findings.route: bad_spec — preserve pending uncertainty separately and settle only exact terminal originals, retaining legacy evidence

findings.evidence: Wrap execution serializes CustodyKeyRegistration, but missing outer-result recovery serializes client.LookupOriginalAsync's CustodyKeyLifecycleOutcome under the same actual field. Equal request identity can therefore recover a different result schema/body.
findings.route: patch — recover the verified original registration representation or remain Unknown

findings.evidence: recording-command-authorize checks Workload(caller,principal,domain), while both dispatch-admit branches only test original-store caller/bytes/Unsent. The checked workload identity/principal is not bound into dispatch; its revocation can win between proof and dispatch without being checked at CAS.
findings.route: bad_spec — bind/revalidate exact workload authorization at dispatch admission

findings.evidence: NativeDaprAuthorityStore publishes archive/checkpoint objects before conditional head commit, using GUID locators. CompletionReserveBytes only reduces serialized checkpoint allowance; no physical free-space reservation or pending completion accounting exists in this store. Failed CAS leaves additional charged physical objects.
findings.route: bad_spec — surviving physical completion/publication accounting and stable native archive retry

findings.evidence: JointPhaseSourceOperationHandler recovery calls Handle/Publish again. If no final file exists after an admitted failed publication, the publisher rereads current guard/protection/streams and signs those later facts as the original phase observation. There is no retained first observation body to recover.
findings.route: bad_spec — immutable inner native measurement publication or Unknown

findings.evidence: Both installation readers call File.ReadAllBytesAsync before checking bytes.Length. Their stated bounds do not prevent oversized allocation or nonregular-path stalls; no upstream bounded descriptor acquisition protects these entrypoints.
findings.route: patch — bounded regular-file acquisition with a finite deadline before allocation

findings.evidence: Preflight obtains four independent readiness receipts sequentially; each call may take under 30 seconds while their combined elapsed time exceeds the authority's 30-second receipt window. Reservation rejects otherwise healthy complete inputs.
findings.route: patch — acquire independent readiness as a bounded fresh set

findings.evidence: Independently confirms the same owner-framing default recovery failure as B6-1 through the actual interface defaults and stable caller payload.

Receiver sends every already-admitted replay-register-exact request only to LookupAsync. The actual RegisterAsync contains guarded retained-unsent/definitive-native-no-event recovery, so the outer retry never reaches that permitted recovery branch.
findings.route: patch — reach exact guarded registration recovery while unknown dispatch remains lookup-only

findings.evidence: Matching publication reservations permit concurrent exact retries. ImmutableFileArchive writes a full unique temporary file before checking the final path and has no per-path writer ownership. Duplicate large copies can consume multiple times the single reserved write budget, including across receiving instances.
findings.route: bad_spec — bounded cross-instance exact publication ownership/deduplication preserving atomic durability

findings.evidence: Pre-verified: native audit tests replace IEventStoreGatewayClient and never exercise QualificationGatewayReadProofs. Changing the mounted stream proof's caller leaves current tests green while the real receiver rejects its caller binding.
findings.route: patch — actual adapter/client/receiving proof and current-revocation regression
